in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One whose existence is longed for or desired

in_hindi.name: Ansit
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Ansh
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ansit एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word अंशित (Anshita), meaning 'Lord Ansh'. Ansh is a Hindu deity associated with cosmic power and the infinite universe.

in_tamil.name: அன்சித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is longed for or wished for

in_telugu.name: Ansit
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ansit ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word अंशित (Anshita), meaning 'Lord Ansh'. Ansh is a Hindu deity associated with cosmic power and the infinite universe.

in_marathi.name: Ansit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word अंशित (Anshita), meaning 'Lord Ansh'. Ansh is a Hindu deity associated with cosmic power and the infinite universe.

in_bengali.name: Ansit

in_bengali.long_meaning: Ansit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word अंशित (Anshita), meaning 'Lord Ansh'. Ansh is a Hindu deity associated with cosmic power and the infinite universe.
